David's lack of that reprimand does not establish that nobody had ever stopped Adonijah or was in the habit of telling him no.
Nathan does not join Adonijah, but saying he sits this out is misleading: he intervenes.

Nathan says he will confirm Bathsheba's words, not that he will back her up exactly as she says them.

The passage does not state what David knows the answer to be.

The passage does not give a reason David worships on his bed.
